paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
notes: Astrophysical constraint on axion-photon coupling from axions produced in neutron star polar-cap vacuum-gap cascades converting to radio photons, using 27 nearby pulsars. Does NOT assume axions are dark matter (so no local DM density). 95% CL limits, strongest for 1e-8 to 1e-5 eV. No numerical table provided; exclusion curve read approximately from Fig. 2 (values ~few×10^-12 to ~10^-11 GeV^-1). Fiducial coupling reference in text is g_agamma~1e-11 GeV^-1.
